kinematic_reference.role: Independent forward-kinematic reference; it does not replace live environment endpoint, distance, or hold fields.
kinematic_reference.source: Separate MuJoCo replay loaded from qpos_after_rad and qvel_after_rad_s, followed by mj_forward and mj_jacSite.

measurement_semantics.live_environment_source: Endpoint and velocity are sampled from the live MuJoCo data after env.step; distance and hold fields are read from the live environment transition and its info record.
measurement_semantics.outcomes: No candidate role or success expectation is imposed.

units.time: control steps; ten simulator substeps per control step
